issue: Isolated ALT 134.4 U/L (4.2x ULN) at Week 8 with normal AST and bilirubin, normal ALT before and after, and no related adverse event recorded; the value may be a transcription error or a clinically significant result with no AE recorded.
query_text: The Week 8 (2014-01-15) ALT result is 134.4 U/L (reference range 6–32 U/L, about 4.2x ULN). ALT was 14 U/L at Week 6 (2014-01-01) and 15 U/L at Week 12 (2014-02-18). AST on 2014-01-15 was 19 U/L and total bilirubin was 10.26 umol/L, both within normal range. No adverse event for raised liver enzymes is recorded. Please check the Week 8 ALT value against the source laboratory report and correct it if it was entered wrongly. If the value is correct, please tell us whether the investigator considers it clinically significant and, if so, whether an adverse event should be recorded.
